doc: Where every field of a lane record lands in an item record. fromLaneRecord() in record-format.mjs implements it. how: copy = the value as written, at the item path; map = converted by the rule in note; reserved = kept empty in piece 1; events = rebuilt from the item's events. The selftest fails when the lane writes a field that has no row here, or a row names a field the lane no longer writes, so a new lane field must state where it goes. Context, not a record field: repo comes from the tick (summary.repo, UPGRADE_AGENT_REPO).

fields.note: The item's own schema is haynes.upgrade-item/v1.
Not the item id: change_key also hashes the changed files and the from versions.
Copied; when the PR has no package table (null) the name is '<repo>#<pr>'.
installed.kind is inferred: digest, semver (dotted numbers, an exact pin like ==1.2.3 included), other, unknown (null).
available.kind is inferred the same way.
Also the basis of the item id.
Also decides source: digest or pinDigest tokens only, and no own image, is image-pin.

LANE-A to A-night, LANE-B-AGENT to B-agent, LANE-B-OWNER to B-owner, EXCLUDED to excluded. BLOCKED to A-night (no stricter finding exists, so the blocker is all that stops lane A), except class facts-incomplete to unknown. Also decides state: BLOCKED is blocked; a hold or vet-hold finding is held; anything else is needed.
Also decides state held (a '/hold:' or '/vet-hold:' finding).
Also decides source: any own image is own-image.
Written by run-night.mjs on lane-A records only; null otherwise.
Written by run-night.mjs on lane-A records only; null otherwise. Tonight's gates, not the item's state: a gate blocker leaves the item needed.
